faqs.a:
The application for a massage parlor license shall constitute consent of the licensee
               and his agents or employees to permit the city police department, code enforcement
               officers, or any other agent of the city to conduct routine inspections of any licensed
               massage parlor during the hours the establishment is conducting business and at other
               times during which activity on the premises is in evidence.
(Code 1981, § 16-21; Ord. No. 3292, § 1, 10-21-1996)
